title: Evaluation under a ring homomorphism
statement: Let $R$ and $S$ be commutative rings, let $f:R\to S$ be a ring homomorphism, let $x$ assign an element of $R$ to each of $n$ inputs, and let $g_1,\ldots,g_m$ be an ordered list of arithmetic gates. Evaluating these gates successively at the inputs obtained by applying $f$ gives the list obtained by applying $f$ to each value in the successive evaluation of the original gates at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite ordered list of gates on $n$ inputs
